title: feat(core): add list item drag reorder
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Adds accessible list-item reorder handles to core live preview, supporting mouse drag and keyboard movement while preserving Markdown structure, numbering style, task state, and atomic undo.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- Issue: n/a
- Roadmap (`docs/ROADMAP.md`): n/a — the capability is tracked by the existing OpenSpec change rather than the current roadmap
- OpenSpec change: `add-missing-features`, task 2.4 — List item drag reorder

Reordering a Markdown list currently requires selecting and moving raw source manually, which is error-prone for loose lists, task items, ordered markers, and parents with nested children. Grip-based reordering makes this a direct editing primitive while keeping Markdown text as the source of truth.

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/core`:
  - **New pure module `src/list-reorder.ts`** — builds one atomic CodeMirror replacement from mdast-derived sibling ranges. Item bodies move as units, list separators remain attached to destination slots, and ordered lists reuse destination markers so sequential, custom-start, and all-ones numbering styles are preserved.
  - **New `src/live-preview-list.ts`** — extracts list rendering from `live-preview.ts` and adds same-level grip handles, mouse drag targeting, visual drop indicators, ArrowUp/ArrowDown movement, Escape cancellation, focus restoration, and listener/style cleanup on blur or widget destruction.
  - **New `src/live-preview-widget.ts`** — extracts the shared lazy/stable widget factory from the live-preview core, reducing the size and responsibility of `live-preview.ts`.
  - **Locale/types wiring** — adds English/Chinese `reorderListItem` labels while keeping the new locale field optional for backward compatibility; resolved locales still provide a required label.
  - Reordering keeps task checkbox state, loose-list spacing, indentation, and complete nested subtrees. Each move is dispatched as one transaction and therefore one undo step.
- `openspec/`:
  - Completes `add-missing-features` task 2.4 and documents subtree/task preservation, ordered-marker behavior, and keyboard reordering.

## Testing / 测试

- [x] Full Vitest suite passes — **551/551** across 35 files (537 before this PR; +14 new cases)
- [x] Affected package builds — `@floatboat/nexus-core` tsup ESM + DTS succeeds; Electron main/preload and renderer production builds succeed
- [x] TypeScript checks — all 12 workspace `tsconfig.json` projects pass `tsc --noEmit`
- [x] New / updated vitest cases:
  - `packages/core/test/list-reorder.test.ts` (14 tests) — unordered/ordered movement, loose spacing, custom/all-ones numbering, nested subtree and nested-sibling indentation, stale/no-op ranges, task state, atomic undo, mouse indicators, keyboard focus restoration, Escape cancellation, and destroy cleanup
  - `packages/core/test/locale.test.ts` — verifies the built-in English locale includes the new accessible label
- [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo — verified mouse dragging across siblings, nested subtree preservation, checked-task state, custom-start ordered numbering, keyboard movement/focus restoration, and one-step undo

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [ ] **CLA signed** — first-time contributor; will be prompted by the CLA bot
- [x] **AI disclosure**: the functional code in this PR was developed with AI assistance (this is a take-home assignment that permits AI tooling). AI-assisted notes: OpenAI Codex drafted the core refactor, implementation, and tests; the behavior was validated with the full automated suite and manual Electron checks. The submitter reviewed and can explain the source-slot reorder algorithm, mdast boundary handling, widget lifecycle cleanup, ordered-marker semantics, atomic transaction design, and keyboard focus restoration.
- [x] **New dependencies**: none
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed (`dist/`, `dist-electron/`, compiled `.js` from `.ts`)
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits — `feat(core): add list item drag reorder`
- [x] Public API changes update package README / types — accessible label added to exported locale/live-preview types; no behavioral API break
- [x] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` → n/a (table implementation unchanged)
- [x] New capability / breaking change → existing OpenSpec `add-missing-features` task 2.4 linked and completed
- [x] Change aligns with project scope (`GOVERNANCE.md` §4) — core Markdown editing primitive, no product-level or vendor-specific integration

## Screenshots / Recordings · 截图或录屏 (UI changes)

Not attached — interaction was verified directly in the Electron demo; detailed scenarios are listed above.

files.patch:
@@ -54,3 +54,18 @@ List items SHALL have grip handles (similar to table rows) that allow drag-and-d
 #### Scenario: Drag preserves indentation
 - **WHEN** a nested list item is dragged
 - **THEN** its indentation level SHALL be preserved after the move
+
+#### Scenario: Drag preserves list item content
+- **WHEN** a list item containing task state or a nested list is dragged
+- **THEN** the complete item subtree SHALL move as one atomic editor change
+- **AND** task checkbox state SHALL be preserved
+
+#### Scenario: Reorder an ordered list
+- **WHEN** an ordered list item is moved to another position
+- **THEN** the destination slot numbering style SHALL be preserved
+
+#### Scenario: Reorder with the keyboard
+- **GIVEN** a list item grip has focus
+- **WHEN** the user presses ArrowUp or ArrowDown
+- **THEN** the item SHALL move one position in that direction when possible
+- **AND** focus SHALL follow the moved item
